rows.en: 1. Any allied unit is shot down.
rows.notes: Listener: player. Loss condition, plain text; preserves one line and the any-one-allied-unit trigger.

rows.en: Th-this reading...!
...What's wrong, Oki?
Hakke robots are heading this way...! They've already broken through the second defense line.
They pretended to retreat, then came after me with a delayed attack? Those Hakke bastards and their petty tricks.
rows.notes: Masato speaks with cruel revived persona; retain contempt and delayed feint.

rows.en: #部隊名 is currently fighting Giganos forces in another area.
I'll leave interception to Daimos and the Getter team stationed at this base.
Hmph. I alone am more than enough for the Hakke.
uncertain: Short Hakke refers to attacking enemy group; avoid forcing people-only Hakkeshu term.

rows.en: What did you say...!?
Oki, don't let the others interfere.
So Masato's personality really has...!?
rows.notes: Deliberate unfinished suspicion about the changed personality.

rows.en: Heh heh heh... At last, the time has come for me to take my revenge.
Come on, come out! Zeorymer of the Heavens!
Aaaah!!
Damn! The surface has been blown away!
Oki, we're heading out!
No, wait. I'll send Masato out in Zeorymer.
J-just him, all alone!?
That's insane!
...We have no other choice now. I need to see everything for myself, too.
There you are...!
rows.notes: Ritsu addresses the newly arriving Zeorymer.

rows.en: Heh... You never learn, do you? Have you come here to die, Ritsu?
Shut up...! I'll make you feel every humiliation I've endured up to this day!
Heh heh heh heh... I'll come over to you now.
You can charge your J-Kaiser while I'm on my way.
rows.notes: J-Kaiser follows existing main glossary and root-supplied licensed Good Smile spelling corroboration; no attack mechanics added.

rows.en: You dare mock me...! Then behold the power of the moon's light!!
...Father...
rows.notes: Kinship address retained; not expanded into an explanation.

rows.en: ...I'm Masaki Kihara! I'm no father of yours!
He destroyed a Hakke robot with just one strike...!!
rows.notes: Restored Masaki as subject and destruction as the context-settled action.

rows.en: These readings...! They're on a whole different scale from before...!
...Wonderful... That's the true power of the Dimensional Coupler System...!
You saw that, AI1... You'll be able to wield power like that, too...!
That guy... That Masato is...!
rows.notes: Source deliberately leaves the identity realization unfinished.

rows.en: Heh, heh heh heh... Dance... Dance, you Hakkeshu! Dance in the palm of my hand!
Heh heh heh heh... Ha ha ha... Haaahahahahaha!!
Heh heh heh... Ritsu, have you come here to die!?
You're too slow, Zeorymer!
How pathetic, Zeorymer! Go ahead and rot away like that!!
I've got to do this...! Everyone came here to help me, too...
I can do it, too... I can do it, too!
rows.notes: Restored the resolve/action implied by preceding resolve to fight; repetition retained.

rows.en: Come on, Hakke robot! Since Zeorymer isn't working right, we'll take you on!
Hmph... You certainly look like more of a challenge than Zeorymer does now...
But everything is powerless before the light of this Moon!!
rows.notes: Moon is the elemental designation in the taunt, not a substituted weapon name.

rows.en: Does this one intend to back up Zeorymer, too!?
Watch out, Ryo! This thing's power is no joke!
I know! Hayato, concentrate!
Don't worry, Ryo! Whatever's going on with Masato, this thing is definitely our enemy!
#女愛称! So Miku really isn't there!?
Y-yes... From the way Zeorymer is moving, that's the only explanation I can think of!
I see... So the girl the Empress abducted had a secret like that...!
rows.notes: Empress refers to Yuratei, consistent with the sourced female ruler; source-short title retained.

rows.en: Damn...! Even so, we can't let them destroy Zeorymer!
What's wrong, Zeorymer? Surely that isn't all the power you have...?
Where are you, Miku!? A-at this rate...!
rows.notes: Deliberate unfinished danger warning retained.

rows.en: Playtime is over! Your power will become the flesh and blood of Medius!
Daimolite's power is certainly appealing, too, but...
rows.notes: Deliberate trailing contrast retained.

rows.en: I know! I'll eliminate anyone who gets in the way of our objective!
Damn... They're after #機体名!!
Get out of my way! Don't interfere with my objective!!
No way! We know what you're after!
Whatever your objective is, I can't let you get away with it if you drag us and Ensign #男愛称 into it!
rows.notes: Restored speaker refusal and preserved involvement of both allies and the named lieutenant. Root glossary review: explicit rank retained as Ensign per male lead profile, matching hospital declaration.

rows.en: Heh heh heh... It seems they can't understand my objective...
Let's settle this, Commander... No, Albero Esto!
Very well! That's what I intend to do, too!
Be careful, Ginga! This guy... He's even more fired up than usual!
Y-yeah! We'll give it everything we've got, too!!
Heh, come at me!
I'll have you show me that power...
Domon Kasshu, watch closely! Medius will evolve into a being that surpasses that devil!
rows.notes: The devil is the enemy entity sought by Albero; no added named identity.

rows.en: So that thing really is your target!
Major Albero...
I know!
I won't let him get in my way!
rows.notes: Him refers to Domon, who answers immediately afterward.

rows.en: Then here I come!
Come at me! I'll use this Medius to take your punches head-on!
Tch, it's sluggish...! ...Is it because of Miku!?
rows.notes: Movement impairment and Miku connection restored from event9 observations; questioning tone retained.

rows.en: Zeorymer is moving more slowly than usual... Did something happen?
Look at that! The part on Zeorymer's chest!
Its chest, you say?
That's strange. Unlike usual, that part isn't glowing.
Could there be something wrong with its power output system...!?
rows.notes: Question about output fault; tentative tone retained.

rows.en: Miku, what's going on!? Explain the situation!
Miku! Why aren't you responding!?
Miku, if you don't regulate its output, Zeorymer will...!
rows.notes: Deliberate unfinished consequence retained.

rows.en: There's still no answer...
Could it be that she isn't aboard Zeorymer?
I-I don't know...!
Could this be like what happened to Masato before...?
rows.notes: Unspecified earlier parallel remains tentative, without inventing its mechanism.

rows.en: Find out where Miku is, right now!
And Getter Team, Daimos, #男愛称 and the others, prepare to sortie! I may need you to head out!
rows.notes: Orders address Getter Team, Daimos and the male lead group; possible sortie retained.

rows.en: Understood!
Oki, I told you not to interfere. ...Besides, I can bring Miku back whenever I want.
At any time...? What does he mean?
rows.notes: Answers the other Masato claiming he can retrieve Miku at any time.

rows.en: ! W-where am I!?
rows.notes: Normal Masato regains awareness; abrupt exclamation and stutter preserved.

rows.en: ...That bastard isn't even using half the power he did last time. What on earth is going on...?
rows.notes: Ritsu compares Zeorymer with their previous battle.

rows.en: Th-this is... the inside of Zeorymer...! Why am I here!?
Masato... Has he returned to his old self?
rows.notes: Oki recognizes the normal personality.

rows.en: Miku! Miku, are you there!?
Answer me, Masato!
Oki! What's happening!?
Listen carefully. We just learned that Miku seems to have been kidnapped by Hau Dragon.
rows.notes: The kidnapping remains reported as apparent, not proven.

rows.en: What!?
But you must fight the enemy right in front of you.
B-but without Miku...!
rows.notes: Deliberate trailing conditional preserved.

rows.en: She's only ever been your co-pilot. Fight him as you are.

rows.notes: Dismayed denial rendered as an interjection.

rows.en: I'm sending out the Getter Team, Daimos and #機体名 now. Hold out until they arrive!
Y-yes!
...Zeorymer's output has fallen drastically compared to last time.
Is it because Miku isn't here after all...? Kihara, what were you planning...?
rows.notes: Direct internal address to Kihara trails off in the source.

rows.en: ...Why? The power of the Heavens should surpass all others...!
rows.notes: Heavens preserves the Zeorymer power motif without expanding a full unit name.

rows.en: ...What was I doing until just now...?
rows.notes: Masato wonders about the lapse in awareness; trailing question preserved.

rows.en: I see... It was the other me again... That vicious, cruel, cunning other me...!
rows.notes: Deliberate trailing other-self description preserved.

rows.en: The me who tried to attack even if it dragged everyone in #部隊名 into it...!
rows.notes: Continues row260 as a fragment; friendly squad caught in the proposed attack, not stated as intended targets.

rows.en: No! That isn't me! That isn't...!!
rows.notes: Interrupted denial retained.

rows.en: Everyone! We're going to cover Masato!
Yeah!
Ryoma, Kazuya... Y-you're... You're going to help me...?
rows.notes: Hesitation preserved; Ryoma corresponds to source full given name, not nickname Ryo.

rows.en: Why would you even ask that now? Of course we are!
But I...!
rows.notes: Deliberate interrupted admission preserved.

rows.en: No matter how we met, I won't abandon a comrade who's fought alongside us all this time.
That's right. I know... how hard you've been trying, Masato.
...You're naive. I still don't trust him completely, you know?
rows.notes: Hayato doubts Masato; naive rebuke retained.

rows.en: H-hey... Cut it out.
Hayato, are you saying you can't trust our comrade?
Yeah. That Masato is one thing... But who knows what the other one's thinking?
rows.notes: Normal Masato distinguished from the other personality.
Silent reaction only; no invented words.

rows.en: The other one...!? What on earth are you talking about?
Heh... You'll have to ask him yourself.
rows.notes: Ask Masato himself, not Hayato.

rows.en: What!?
Everyone, watch out! More enemies are heading this way!!
They're... Hokushin's Six!!
Tch! Those bastards picked a hell of a place to show up!
rows.notes: Coarse irritation retained.

rows.en: Hokushin's Six, I don't recall summoning you. Stay out of my way.
rows.notes: Ritsu addresses the uninvited group.

rows.en: Our task is to draw the Nadesico away... We will do as we please.
rows.notes: Diversion intended to draw away Nadesico, not assist Ritsu.

rows.en: Medius Locus! A-at a time like this...!!
rows.notes: Deliberate trailing alarm retained.

rows.en: This is bad! In that position, they'll catch us in a pincer attack!

uncertain: Silent ……… rendered '...'. The line is reused in i00r0a:3/16/62/97 (the interlude), so it is a neutral silence.

rows.en: #男愛称, where are you going!?
I'll hold him off here! I'm counting on you to protect Masato!
rows.notes: Hugo requests others protect Masato while he holds off Medius; direction preserved.

rows.en: #男愛称... The time has come for you two to fulfill your true purpose.
rows.notes: Plural refers to both lead pilots.

rows.en: Our true purpose...!?
Yes... Become the flesh and blood of Medius Locus here, along with #機体名.
rows.notes: Assimilation threat retains flesh-and-blood image.

rows.en: ...You're saying we should settle this, Captain!
Yes. I'll end your suffering. Then you can die and join Folia and my men.
rows.notes: Explicit death threat preserved; my men follows Albero speaking of fallen subordinates.

rows.en: Shut up! Today I'll destroy the source of all this... that Medius Locus!!
Medius is the source of it all? Hmph. You're sorely mistaken.
This machine was built to surpass even that Devil Gundam.
What else could it be but the source of all this!?
What do you intend to do once you have even more power than that thing!?
rows.notes: That thing refers to Devil Gundam in row293.

rows.en: I'll teach you the answer... through your death.
I'm not going to drop dead in a place like this!
An admirable spirit. But today, even that will come to nothing.
Don't think everything will go your way!!
#女愛称, bring the TE Engine to full power!
#男愛称, don't get worked up! Calm down!
Just do as you're told!!
But I won't release the limiter! All right!?
rows.notes: Limiter refusal and emphatic confirmation preserved.

rows.en: Quit your griping! Hurry up and raise the output!
A-all right! Deploying the Terminus Energy absorption plates! Opening the bypass!
rows.notes: Technical deployment calls preserved.

rows.en: You're all set, #男愛称!!
All right...!
#機体名's output just shot up... Hehehe... That's the way, #女愛称.
rows.notes: Thought directed at female lead, two exact placeholders retained.

rows.en: Show me and AI1 what you two can do. And then...
rows.notes: Deliberate trailing and then preserved.

rows.en: Here I come, Captain!!
Come...! I'll put an end to our cursed past right here!
Kazuya, are you all right!?
Ginga, everyone... You came for us!
Everyone, please launch.
It seems there's a lot going on, but I'm counting on you to support Ryoma and the others.
rows.notes: Ruri requests support for Ryoma and others, direction preserved.

rows.en: It disappeared!?
rows.notes: Source does not identify what disappeared; neutral it retained.

rows.en: What the hell is going on!?
We can investigate that later... Harry, what about the other enemy units?
rows.notes: Harry is the body nickname; no speaker-prefill substitution.

rows.en: We can investigate that later... For now, please destroy the remaining enemy units.

rows.en: U-ugh...!!
M-Masato!!
Heh heh heh... That settles this battle.
So it really is because Miku isn't here...!?
rows.notes: Restored the cause of Zeorymer's failure; thought sequence explains Miku's absence.

rows.en: Masaki told me she was only needed to control the data...
But without Miku, Zeorymer's output and attack power are both reduced.
Just what secret is hidden within her...!?
rows.notes: Meaning correction: secret hidden within Miku, not intentionally concealed by her.

rows.en: ...I'll destroy it... The Zeorymer that Masaki Kihara built...! And Masaki Kihara himself!!
rows.notes: Two destruction targets retained: Zeorymer and Masaki himself.

rows.en: T-tell me!!

rows.notes: Wordless offended reaction retained.

rows.en: Why do you hate Masaki Kihara!? Because he betrayed Tekkoryu!?
...That's not why...! He toyed with me... with my very life! I can never forgive him for that!
What...!?
...Masato Akitsu... You cannot see it. This face of mine...!
rows.notes: Face remains unseen by Masato; no visible-face claim.

rows.en: I've lived with this woman's face...!
I was born a warrior and raised to fight, yet the face I was given was that of a woman!

rows.notes: Silence checked at all five original uses.

rows.en: Sometimes you must live with what you hate most...! Can you understand how that tears you apart!?
rows.notes: Question concerns present suffering from living with one's most hated feature.

rows.en: Th-that's...!
rows.notes: Masato starts a rebuttal then stops; deliberate fragment. Stage28-only context correction: Masato trails off answering Ritsu about current suffering; past tense was unsupported. Independently reviewed by Stage28 worker5 and root; earlier owner unchanged.

rows.en: ...One day, I learned... I learned the truth.
rows.notes: Source sentence continues in 338; retained the lead-in as discovery.

rows.en: That Masaki Kihara was the one who created me...
rows.notes: Deliberate complement fragment continuing 337.

rows.en: That he was the one who created this face of mine... like this...!
rows.notes: Parallel complement fragment continuing 337-338.

rows.en: Created you...!?
rows.notes: Echo question; restored the person created from 338.

rows.en: Yes. All of the Hakkeshu are artificial life-forms created by Masaki Kihara...!
...I found the data... The program data Kihara had planted in us...
What the hell are those guys doing!?
I don't know. We can't intercept their communications from here...
...Kihara made it so that, once we grew up... we would all bear some trauma...
rows.notes: Source sentence spans 345-346; retained trailing lead-in.

rows.en: He sealed factors into our genes that would drive us to destroy one another.
rows.notes: Restored Kihara as actor using he; genes cause mutual destruction.

rows.en: For Taiha, unrequited love...
rows.notes: Deliberate example-list fragment; no dropped standalone subject.

rows.en: For Aen and Tau, a sisterly love that made them hate each other...
rows.notes: Deliberate example-list fragment; paradoxical sisterly love and hatred retained; Aen/Tau source-short names.

rows.en: And for me, a woman's face.
rows.notes: Deliberate list continuation; source-short description.

rows.en: Will you laugh at me for being weak, Masato? But no one can understand this suffering...!
I swore... I would never become what Masaki Kihara wanted!
And by hating my creator, Masaki, with all my heart...
rows.notes: Deliberately unfinished clause completed by 353.

rows.en: Heh heh, I finally won!
I'm done talking. Die... and take the blood of Masaki within you with you...!
rows.notes: Death threat includes Masaki's blood within Masato.

rows.en: ...Masaki's blood, you say? Don't make me laugh...!
rows.notes: Masaki personality begins surfacing; preserve prefilled Masato label through 374.

rows.en: What...?
Who do you think I am, Ritsu?
There can be no victory for you...!
!! Burn to ashes! J-Kaiser, full power!!
Hmph, your struggles are futile...
That's my line!
What can Zeorymer do without Miku Himuro!?
Without Miku... you say?
That's right! That woman is now being held captive inside Tekkoryu's fortress!
Thanks to that, Zeorymer can't unleash its true power, can it!?
Heh, heh heh heh...
What's so funny!?
Ignorance is a pitiful thing, Ritsu. All I need to do is call the missing part back.
rows.notes: Dehumanizing part describes Miku, not ordinary machinery.

rows.en: A part...!?
Exactly...!
Zeorymer! Call it back! Your Dimensional Coupler System!!
rows.notes: Masaki commands return of Miku as the missing Dimensional Coupler System; preserve source system apposition.

rows.en: Wh-what...!? What just happened!?
The light has returned to Zeorymer's chest...!?
Heh, heh heh heh... You're back, Miku.
...Masato... Masato... MASATO... MASATO...
rows.notes: Four repetitions retained; capitals mark source shift to robotic katakana. Honorific dropped.
Two mechanically segmented repetitions retained; honorific dropped.

rows.en: I-impossible...! Th-that's the Dimensional Coupler System's...!?
rows.notes: Source trails off after system possessive; retained deliberately unfinished phrase.

rows.en: Don't think you'll die an easy death... Ritsu! Let's go, Miku!
rows.notes: Painful-death threat fully retained.

rows.en: A-aren't you Masato...!?
Heh heh heh...
It can't be... You're...!
rows.notes: Recognition trails off; identity remains unspoken.

rows.en: ...It's about time I settled this, Zeorymer!
rows.notes: Separate event 15 follows event 14; no causal continuation assumed.

rows.en: #男愛称! #女愛称!!
rows.notes: Same row appears in events 16 and 19; placeholders preserved.

rows.en: Wh-what's happening!?
I-it took a direct hit to the chest...!!
rows.notes: Restored struck unit subject; both actual events concern lead unit chest hit.

rows.en: N-no!!
A-are you serious!? This is no joke!!
Answer me! #男愛称! #女愛称!!
H-hey! This can't be real!? You're kidding, right!?
Answer me! Please, answer me, both of you!!
U-ughhh...!
#女愛称!!
#男愛称...! #男愛称... A-are you all right...!?
rows.notes: Female lead calls male lead twice and asks about his condition; both occurrences reviewed.

rows.en: #女愛称! Is #男愛称 safe!?
A-aah... ...N-no!!
rows.notes: Shock at missing forward cockpit seat, as next row explains.

rows.en: What's wrong, #女愛称!?
The h-hatch... The front seat... It's gone...!
rows.notes: Female lead discovers the front cockpit seat missing after the chest hit; hatch and seat shock retained. Retained source fragment: Hatch/seat description breaks under shock, but predicate restored.

rows.en: N-no...! This... This can't...!
rows.notes: Female lead horrified; interrupted repetition retained. Meaning correction: Preserved the second stunned thought as an unfinished source fragment instead of completing it with happening. Retained source fragment: Intentional shocked repetitions remain unfinished.

rows.en: ...So you've died, #男愛称.
rows.notes: Albero addresses the presumed-dead male lead; death is explicit, not merely departure.

rows.en: Now... you won't have to suffer anymore.
rows.notes: Source context and all actual uses checked; subject, action and tone retained.

rows.en: U-uuugh...!! Aaaaah!!
rows.notes: Source vocal reaction, name call, apology or shocked silence retained; no narrative completion added. Retained source fragment: Vocal cry only.

rows.en: ...#女愛称, his death is unmistakably your fault.
rows.notes: Eldy cruelly blames the female lead for the male lead death; male referent settled by source pronoun and lead placeholder.

rows.en: Your distress gave Medius time to grow... and led him to his death.
rows.notes: Female lead distress is the cause of Medius growth time and the male lead death, both preserved.
Source vocal reaction, name call, apology or shocked silence retained; no narrative completion added. Retained source fragment: Silent shock only.

rows.en: Do you know why I hid the fact that I was aboard Medius from you?
rows.notes: Eldy reveals deliberate concealment from her former pupil.

rows.en: Y-you don't mean...!?
rows.notes: Female lead unfinished realization retained. Retained source fragment: Incomplete horrified realization.

rows.en: Yes. It was to shake you up at a moment like this.
rows.notes: Answers row408: deliberate psychological destabilization.

rows.en: I'd already analyzed that particular weakness of yours.
rows.notes: Source context and all actual uses checked; subject, action and tone retained.

rows.en: M-Middi... You...!
rows.notes: Source surname address uses glossary Middi; shocked unfinished accusation retained. Retained source fragment: Middi name plus unfinished you accusation.

rows.en: I thought I taught you this long ago... Always analyze the situation calmly, and learn to handle any eventuality.
rows.notes: Eldy invokes the earlier teaching: calm analysis at all times and readiness for every situation. Meaning correction: Restored reproachful expectation in taught-you-hazu, instead of flat certainty.
Female lead cannot finish her self-defense; intentional fragment. Retained source fragment: Repeated unfinished I statements.

rows.en: Heh heh heh... That was an expensive lesson.
rows.notes: Tuition metaphor renders the deadly lesson, not a literal invoice.

rows.en: But for old times' sake, I'll give you one more chance.
rows.notes: Source context and all actual uses checked; subject, action and tone retained.
Female lead to male; surprised reaction. Decision: Restore settled subject/action; keep spoken tone and source row boundary. Retained source fragment/continuation: Huh...!? is surprise interjection.

rows.en: Put this experience to use and become a proper TE Absorber pilot.
rows.notes: Proper pilot contrasts with the current supporting role; no pilot promotion rank invented.

rows.en: Then come challenge this reborn Medius and my AI1 again.
rows.notes: Source context and all actual uses checked; subject, action and tone retained.

rows.en: ...If you have the will to do it.
rows.notes: Conditional qualification of row418 invitation, retained in separate row. Retained source fragment: Conditional continuation of prior row.

rows.en: Y-you're... going to let me go!?
rows.notes: Source context and all actual uses checked; subject, action and tone retained.

rows.en: Yes. In exchange for your life...
rows.notes: Sentence trails across source rows421-422; exchange direction is Eldy taking engine while sparing female lead. Retained source fragment: Sentence continues into row422; exchange is not completed here.

rows.en: I'll be taking #機体名's TE Engine.
rows.notes: Source context and all actual uses checked; subject, action and tone retained.

rows.en: !! You're going to put it in Medius!?
rows.notes: Female lead infers installing the taken TE Engine in Medius; action and subject restored.

rows.en: Heh heh heh... Until we meet again, #女姓名.
rows.notes: Source context and all actual uses checked; subject, action and tone retained.

rows.en: #男愛称! #女愛称!!
rows.notes: Source vocal reaction, name call, apology or shocked silence retained; no narrative completion added. Retained source fragment: Two name calls only.

rows.en: ...Now we have Lasmunanium and AI1... and the TE Engine as well.
rows.notes: Source context and all actual uses checked; subject, action and tone retained.

rows.en: Now... Let's go, Albero. We have no more business here.
rows.notes: Source context and all actual uses checked; subject, action and tone retained.

rows.en: Harry! What happened to those two!?
rows.notes: Body nickname Harry follows glossary; prefilled speaker Hari remains unchanged elsewhere.

rows.en: The cockpit block was forcibly ejected before the unit exploded...!
rows.notes: Forced ejection occurs before explosion; refers to the cockpit block without asserting both pilots survived.

rows.en: But in that condition...
rows.notes: Hari trails off while implying bleak survival odds; preserves unfinished inference. Meaning correction: Removed the unsupported they referent; source deliberately leaves the grim inference incomplete. Retained source fragment: Intentional unfinished survival inference; no subject or conclusion invented.

rows.en: You dumbass! Check with your own eyes before you say something like that!
rows.notes: Saburota rebukes Hari for unverified pessimism; insult retained.

rows.en: I-I'm sorry...!
rows.notes: Source vocal reaction, name call, apology or shocked silence retained; no narrative completion added.

rows.en: ...Harry, send a rescue team out at once and recover the cockpit block.
rows.notes: Order to Harry to send rescue and recover block; four occurrences checked.

rows.en: And what about the other enemy units?
rows.notes: Ruri asks about remaining enemy units; verb restored.

rows.notes: Ruri orders other allies to destroy remaining enemies; omitted action restored.

rows.en: N-uuugh...!!
rows.notes: Source vocal reaction, name call, apology or shocked silence retained; no narrative completion added. Retained source fragment: Vocal groan only.

rows.en: Ghh... We're in a dangerous state, Albero. I'm handing control of the unit over to AI1.
rows.notes: Eldy reports dangerous unit condition and takes control away from Albero; event20 variant uses different preceding report.

rows.en: Don't meddle, Eldy!!
rows.notes: Source context and all actual uses checked; subject, action and tone retained.

rows.en: Do you intend to lose Medius and AI1 here...!?
rows.notes: Source context and all actual uses checked; subject, action and tone retained.

rows.notes: Source context and all actual uses checked; subject, action and tone retained.
